nativeHitTest.result: The full-screen sibling dismissal layer consumed a visible model-row touch; the picker closed while the connector sequence and thread model selection remained unchanged.

diagnosis.cause: On Lynxtron Desktop, the full-screen sibling dismissal layer won native hit testing over the visually higher model-picker panel despite their CSS z-index values.

repair.structure: The route root owns outside dismissal. The picker panel catches internal taps, and the transparent picker surface is event-through rather than a competing full-screen hit target.

native.input: DevTool Input.emulateTouchFromMouseEvent on the measured model trigger and model row

productLossClosed: A visible native model row no longer dismisses without executing its selection handler.
Native touch changes the composer label, active thread selection, and persisted model selection through the main connector.
evidenceBoundary: The expanded provider/query/empty native flow reached all three states but its DevTool session disconnected during final teardown; it is not used to claim additional coverage.
Native physical keyboard typing, keyboard navigation, and focus-return remain pending-user-session evidence.
classification.policy: No state weights, denominator entries, filters, thresholds, or residual policy changed.
